{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma unit''' was a component in [[Tagge Mining Company]]'s [[AEA-500 mineral extractor]]. They were used to filter valuable [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ores]] out of raw material drawn into the extractor.
